project_name: PontoFlow - Sistema de Controle de Ponto Eletrônico e Jornada

theme_strategy.design_archetype: Swiss Precision & Modern Operational Clarity (Authority, Clean Utility, Human Warmth)
aesthetic_principles: Ultra-clean typographic hierarchy with tactile micro-interactions
Mobile-first prominent punch clock interface for employees (massive touch-friendly tap target, clear live status)
High-density operational clarity for managers and admins (organized Bento grid, clear tables, status pills, minimal visual noise)
Accessible high-contrast palette with deep indigo-slate anchors, crisp neutral stone surfaces, and vibrant emerald active/punch kinetic triggers

typesetting_rules.caption: text-sm font-medium tracking-normal text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400
typesetting_rules.labels: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

entry_surfaces./login: split branded auth screen — dark atmospheric company positioning & live clock left panel, white clean structured role-switching login form right
entry_surfaces./: redirects authenticated session based on user role (employee punch clock OR admin dashboard)
entry_surfaces./funcionario: mobile-first punch clock console — dominant real-time punch card top with pulse state, timeline summary mid, quick mirror & request triggers bottom
entry_surfaces./gestor: high-density management command center — squad presence KPI strip top, pending approval queue center, team punch ledger right
entry_surfaces./admin: executive dashboard — key operational indicators top bento grid, mirror filters & reports table center, company audit & employee manager drawer right

mobile_employee_view.punch_hero_button: w-full min-h-[160px] sm:min-h-[180px] rounded-3xl p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center shadow-xl transition-all duration-200 active:scale-[0.98]

admin_dashboard_bento.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-8

motion_and_interactions.guidelines: No superfluous or dizzying animations. Use purposeful micro-interactions with spring physics for punch action and tab transitions.
motion_and_interactions.punch_pulse: Subtle radar-pulse ring animation around the active punch button indicating ready state
motion_and_interactions.toast_feedback: Immediate sonner feedback with audit receipt confirmation ID upon registering punch
motion_and_interactions.modals_and_drawers: Smooth slide-in sheet for adjustment requests and justification uploads with focus trap and escape key handler

accessibility.wcag_level: WCAG AA compliant (minimum 4.5:1 text contrast on all surfaces)
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full keyboard tab ordering across punch clock, filters, date pickers, and tables
accessibility.screen_readers: Aria live regions for live digital clock updates and punch confirmation alerts
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48px touch targets for all mobile actions (punch button exceeds 120px height for ultimate thumb ergonomics)

component_structure.app_shell: frontend/src/App.tsx (role-based protected routing: Employee, Manager, Admin, Super Admin, Login)

custom_components.name: PunchClockHero
custom_components.purpose: Prominent real-time employee punch card with live UTC-3 digital clock, dynamic current step label (Entrada -> Intervalo -> Retorno -> Saída), GPS/IP detection simulator indicator, and large one-tap button.

custom_components.name: DailyPunchTimeline
custom_components.purpose: 4-slot status visualizer for the day (Entrada, Saída Int., Retorno Int., Saída) with timestamps and status badges.

custom_components.name: EspelhoPontoTable
custom_components.purpose: Comprehensive timesheet table conforming to Brazilian labor standards: Data | Entrada | Saída Int | Retorno Int | Saída | Total Trabalhado | Saldo/Horas Extras/Atraso | Status | Ações (Solicitar Ajuste).

custom_components.name: AdjustmentRequestModal
custom_components.purpose: Modal to request missing punch record adjustments or justify absences with document/medical certificate upload.

custom_components.name: ApprovalQueueCard
custom_components.purpose: Manager & Admin card for 1-click Approve / Reject with justification notes on employee punch adjustments.

custom_components.name: AdminIndicatorsBento
custom_components.purpose: High-density KPI strip showing Active Employees, Present Now, On Lunch, Absent, Delayed, Pending Requests, Overtime Balance.

custom_components.name: EmployeeManagementModal
custom_components.purpose: CRUD dialog for employee profiles, department assignment, journey/work schedule configuration (e.g. 08:00-18:00 com 1h intervalo, 12x36, etc.).

custom_components.name: ExportReportDialog
custom_components.purpose: Export dialog for timesheets and audit logs in CSV / Excel (XLSX) and printable PDF/Espelho format.

custom_components.name: AuditTrailDrawer
custom_components.purpose: Immutable chronological audit log viewer displaying timestamps, IP address, user agent, actor, and change history.

testing_attributes.convention: kebab-case data-testid on every interactive trigger, form input, table row, and balance indicator

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement seed data with 3 distinct accounts: Super Admin / Empresa Admin (admin@pontoflow.com.br), Gestor de Equipe (gestor@pontoflow.com.br), and Funcionário (maria.silva@pontoflow.com.br) with one-click quick demo login buttons for seamless evaluation.

Implement robust Brazilian labor rule calculation logic: standard 8h/day (44h/week), automatic calculation of worked hours, meal break intervals, positive overtime balance (banco de horas / HE 50%), and delay/deficit calculations.

Keep employee interface (§17) ultra simple: greeting, current journey schedule (ex: 08:00 - 18:00), dynamic live status, huge tactile punch button with current required punch type, and list of today's records.

Strictly follow Portuguese (PT-BR) vocabulary: 'Registrar Ponto', 'Entrada', 'Saída para Intervalo', 'Retorno do Intervalo', 'Saída', 'Espelho de Ponto', 'Banco de Horas', 'Solicitações de Ajuste', 'Aprovado', 'Pendente', 'Rejeitado', 'Jornada de Trabalho'.
Support full timesheet export with CSV generation and formatted printable HTML/PDF mirror summary.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes and adhere to WCAG AA contrast ratios.
